get.summary: Deletes a playlist folder, releasing its contents.
get.description: OpenSubsonic extension name `playlistFolders` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Deletes a folder from the authenticated user's playlist organization. The folder does not have to be empty: the folder and the placements it held are removed, child folders are re-parented to the deleted folder's parent, and playlists are never modified or deleted.

parameters.name: playlistFolderId
parameters.description: ID of the playlist folder to delete.

post.summary: Deletes a playlist folder, releasing its contents.
post.description:
OpenSubsonic extension name `playlistFolders` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Deletes a folder from the authenticated user's playlist organization. The folder does not have to be empty: the folder and the placements it held are removed, child folders are re-parented to the deleted folder's parent, and playlists are never modified or deleted.

Requires OpenSubsonic extension name `formPost` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`).

playlistFolderId.description: ID of the playlist folder to delete.
